supporting_observations.claim: The repeated HTTPS proxy tunnels between 13:37 and 14:07 UTC went to update.chartmate-imaging.com, the inventoried ChartMate updater destination.

The recurring connections are attributable to C:\Program Files\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe: its process start is recorded before the first check, and its process ID is associated with the subsequent proxy connections.
The observed checks recur at approximately five-minute intervals, consistent with the inventoried ChartMate update-check behavior.
The endpoint connections shown in Sysmon and Windows Filtering Platform records are to the explicit proxy at 10.30.20.30:8080; the proxy records identify the tunneled ChartMate hostname.
Other recorded activity includes Explorer settings changes and loading of a 7-Zip DLL; these records do not link that activity to the periodic ChartMate connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the recurring ChartMate checks from 13:37:44 through 14:07:42, but do not show corresponding proxy connections at the start of the alert's stated interval around 13:30 (T016-00078 through T016-00085).
Proxy records identify the CONNECT hostname, but the supplied evidence does not expose the contents of the HTTPS tunnel (for example, the update payload).
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the content, authenticity, or integrity of any update transferred through the ChartMate HTTPS tunnels.
The evidence does not establish whether there were additional periodic connections during the alert interval that are not represented in the supplied records.
The unrelated Explorer and DLL events do not, on these records alone, establish persistence or a connection to the reported network anomaly.
